How OTP & Timer Verification Works

Professional private chauffeurs for your owned vehicle with guaranteed transparent duty tracking.

1

Book & Receive OTP

Book your slot. You instantly receive a unique 4-digit Ride Start OTP on your screen and on WhatsApp.

2

Driver Arrives

Our verified chauffeur reaches your doorstep in uniform 15 minutes before the scheduled time slot.

3

Share OTP to Start

Share your OTP with the driver. When entered into the admin panel, the live duty timer starts ticking.

4

Close Duty & Pay

At your destination, the ride closes, timer stops, and an exact duty duration invoice is sent to WhatsApp.
